meta.title: Acid Room — Studio credentials 2026
meta.description: Credentials deck for Acid Room, a Glasgow brand and motion studio for music, sport and food: point of view, three rules, three cases with measured results, clients, a client voice, and how a project runs.

slides.eyebrow: Acid Room · Brand and motion studio · Glasgow · Credentials 2026
slides.heading: We make brands you can read from across the street.
slides.lead: Identity, motion and packaging for music, sport and food.
slides.notes: Say the line, then show the wall. Do not explain the studio before the work.

slides.heading: Our work has to win a wet poster wall at night
slides.lead: If it fails at 20 metres in the rain, we redraw it.

slides.heading: Three rules decide every brand we ship

slides.body:
One colour, owned outright.
One weight of type, set big.
Every mark passes the 20-metre test.

slides.heading: Northgate FC sold 41,000 crest shirts in week one
slides.lead: A 1920s crest redrawn for screens, scarves and a stand 90 metres away.

slides.heading: Low Tide sold out 9 days faster with one acid type system
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 450 750'><rect width='450' height='750' fill='%23F5D200'/><g font-family='Barlow,Arial Black,Arial' font-weight='900' fill='%231C1C1C'><text x='35' y='230' font-size='150'>LOW</text><text x='35' y='370' font-size='150'>TIDE</text><path d='M35 420 Q110 380 185 420 T335 420 T415 420' stroke='%231C1C1C' stroke-width='10' fill='none'/><text x='35' y='520' font-size='34'>PORTOBELLO BEACH</text><text x='35' y='565' font-size='34'>22–24 AUG 2026</text><text x='35' y='690' font-size='26'>SOLD OUT</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: Low Tide festival poster: LOW TIDE in heavy black type on acid yellow, a wave line, and a SOLD OUT stamp.
slides.body: One typeface, one wave line, one yellow on every ticket, wristband and stage screen. Sold out in 12 days, against 21 days in 2025.
